repairs.quote: Passive: Malzahar's other Abilities give him a stack when cast (max 2). Active: Malzahar summons a Voidling plus an additional Voidling per stack. Voidlings last 8/8/9/9/10 seconds and deal (12/14/16/18/20 + (5 ~ 65) + (40% bonus Attack Damage) + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage each hit. Voidlings deal 300% damage to lane minions affected by Malefic Visions. Voidlings deal 50% damage to epic monsters.
